notes: debugger-agent: root cause of REMAINING LAN freeze fixed in Hero.java with supporting logging in NetworkManager.java and GameScene.java
Root cause: Hero.act() called receiveActionAsync() unconditionally on EVERY act() call for remote hero, including intermediate steps of a multi-step walk where curAction was already set
During intermediate walk steps, this started a stale reader that blocked on readByte() and consumed the NEXT turn's action packet early
When the walk completed, ready() cleared curAction, losing the consumed action — next remote turn had no action to receive → permanent freeze
Fix: guard receiveActionAsync() with (curAction == null) in Hero.act() — reader only starts at the true beginning of a remote turn
Logging: added LAN_DEBUG tag logging to NetworkManager.sendAction(), receiveActionAsync(), Hero.act() LAN block, Hero.handle(), GameScene.notifyActorThread(), GameScene.update() LAN poll
Tests: 6 new tests in LanMultiStepWalkFreezeTest — 3 confirm buggy path behavior, 3 confirm fixed path behavior
All 158 LAN tests pass after fix — no regressions
